name: nvp capital
identity_check: Confirmed as the New York seed firm founded by Dan Borok and Vaughn Crowe (Pulse 2.0 Fund II article), investing in vertical AI and enterprise software; portfolio named there includes Pair Team, Vulcan Elements and Class8. Not Newark Venture Partners (also abbreviated NVP) and not N&V Capital. Firm's own website not located.

conflicts.reason: Fetched press pages put the announcement in mid-November 2025; the October date is unverified.

open_items: Two rounds recorded, not three. A third candidate, Thoughtly ($5.5M seed, April-May 2026), has conflicting lead roles in search results (company release: Armory Square leads with nvp participating; nvp: co-lead) and the AlleyWatch page fetched did not name nvp, so it was left out. Reaxiomatic (pre-seed, June 2026) was seen only in search results.

Human Archive stage: SiliconANGLE does not label the round; other coverage in search results calls it seed (one outlet says Series A); recorded as seed on the strength of that search-result coverage only; treat as lower confidence. SiliconANGLE does not separate leads from participants.
Firm website, check size, application route and cold-inbound policy not found; nvp.capital and nvpcap.com did not resolve or returned 403.
Search results mention a Fund III Form D (target $100M); not verified.
